qualifications: This unchanged replay establishes timing/algebra and prediction associations. It does not prove routing, preparation, normal lag or insufficient static motor capacity caused the departure. No new controller or physics settings.
Predicted patch exposure is kinematic geometry, not a forecast of force onset. Future force presence, pressure share and occupancy are descriptive associations, never an accuracy gate.

Downhill direction is normalized projection of gravity onto the interval pressure-normal tangent; project all signed contact force, model gravity and their sum separately. These are sampled exported-force diagnostics, not exact solver impulses, root acceleration, or motor/gravity work attribution.
A contact-force direction and geometric patch exposure are different observables.
Whole-COM force residual is a diagnostic of sampled exported forces and frame/quadrature assumptions, not a fitted force correction.
Body-root velocity may change from both COM translation and body rotation; do not equate root acceleration to net force/mass.
Force presence at a selected future sample does not make the original kinematic preview a force-onset predictor.
Prepared residual is based on hypothetical drive rate at frozen current velocity; actual future speed includes motor dynamics and later feedback.
